summary: Complaints centre on waterlogging on the roads and markets of Shikarpur town, long power cuts, a CHC accused of sending patients to buy medicines outside, and a dilapidated Khurja-Shikarpur road, while the main appreciation is a started road widening and quick compensation for expressway land, though most of the town works are still tendered or sanctioned rather than delivered.

positives.english: Widening work on the Anupshahr road has started at last
positives.hindi: अनूपशहर वाली सड़क का चौड़ीकरण शुरू हो गया है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (12 May 2025): widening of the Anupshahr-Shikarpur road has begun, cost Rs 31.28 crore, first instalment of over Rs 10 crore received. The road connects Shikarpur and Khurja with Anupshahr; the article does not say which stretch is being widened, and it gives no completion date. Route-level, so AC membership of the stretch is not confirmed.

positives.english: Farmers get their land compensation in the bank within seven days of the deed
positives.hindi: बैनामे के सात दिन में किसानों के खाते में मुआवजा पहुंच रहा है
positives.basis: ETV Bharat (2 Jul 2026): SDM Ravindra Pratap Singh says RTGS payment reaches farmers within 7 days of the sale deed. About 62 deeds done in Shikarpur tehsil for the Bulandshahr-Jewar (Greenfield Link) expressway, about 6 km of which falls in Shikarpur tehsil. This is the official claim; no farmer confirmation is reported and the amount is not stated.

positives.english: *Water pipelines are to be laid in Muftiwara and Kotsher Khan
positives.hindi: *मुफ्तीवाड़ा और कोटशेर खां में पानी की पाइपलाइन बिछने वाली है
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (3 Oct 2026) says Shikarpur Nagar Palika has finished tendering about Rs 1.22 crore of works, including pipelines of 783 m in Muftiwara (ward 4) and 1,490 m in Kotsher Khan (ward 19). The benefit is planned, not confirmed delivered, and no start date is reported.

positives.english: *Money is sanctioned to repair our broken roads and drains in town
positives.hindi: *नगर की टूटी सड़कें और नालियां बनवाने का पैसा मंज़ूर हो गया है
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (30 Sep 2026) says Shikarpur Nagar Palika Parishad will spend Rs 2.90 crore on 20 works, mainly damaged roads, drains and culverts, funded from the 15th Finance Commission, State Finance Commission and municipal funds. The article gives no timeline and no completion report, so this is sanctioned money, not delivered work.

positives.english: *Fifteen handpumps in town are to be repaired
positives.hindi: *शहर के 15 हैंडपंप ठीक कराए जाने हैं
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (3 Oct 2026) lists re-boring of 15 India Mark handpumps among the Rs 1.22 crore works in Shikarpur town, and says the tender process is complete. Repair is planned; the article does not report it as done.

negatives.english: Light rain floods our roads, the market and the front of the CHC
negatives.hindi: हल्की बारिश में शिकारपुर की सड़कें, बाज़ार और सीएचसी के सामने पानी भर जाता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (23 Aug 2026) names Balaji Market, the Kotwali turn and the road in front of Government Girls Inter College in Shikarpur town as waterlogged; residents say silted drains and irregular cleaning are the cause and blame garbage in a culvert; EO Sevaram Rajbhar and EO Neetu Singh say drains were cleaned and problem spots will be inspected. Royal Bulletin (23 Aug 2026) reports main roads and crossings flooded in Shikarpur Nagar after light rain. Dynamite News (9 May 2026) names waterlogging in front of the CHC and block office in the Nagar Palika area. Amar Ujala (7 Jul 2026) reports the same spot on the Khurja-Shikarpur road in front of the CHC and block office. The Syana section of the Amar Ujala article is excluded because Syana is not confirmed inside this AC.

negatives.english: Power was off for 36 hours in Shikarpur even after a new cable was laid
negatives.hindi: नया केबल डालने के बाद भी शिकारपुर में 36 घंटे बिजली गुल रही
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (30 Jun 2026), headline and body: a storm and rain caused breakdowns in the Shikarpur feeders (Mangraul and Chitsaun), and the outage in Shikarpur continued for 36 hours even after a new cable was laid. The Executive Engineer says a 33 KVA line broke down in the storm and was fixed overnight. The article's other areas (Dibai, Narsena, Balrampur) are not part of this item. Feeder village membership is not confirmed.

negatives.english: It is alleged that patients are told to buy medicines from outside the CHC
negatives.hindi: आरोप है कि सीएचसी में मरीजों को दवा बाहर से खरीदने को कहा जाता है
negatives.basis: Knews (report dated 10 Sep 2026 per article metadata): allegations that poor patients at Shikarpur CHC were sent to private medical stores, and that some doctors wrote prescriptions for outside medicines, with a commission-taking claim. The article says these allegations are not independently confirmed. CMO Dr Sunil Kumar Dohri is quoted saying all necessary medicines are available. Allegation only.

negatives.english: Stray cattle wreck our crops and sugarcane dues are still pending
negatives.hindi: आवारा पशु फसल उजाड़ते हैं और गन्ने का बकाया पड़ा है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (14 Jul 2025): Bharatiya Kisan Union farmers from Jakhaita village walked to the Shikarpur tehsil and listed crop damage by stray cattle, low electricity, dilapidated roads and unpaid sugarcane dues; a memorandum went to the SDM and CO and no official response is reported. The district-wide BKU demands in ETV Bharat (4 Apr 2026) also include stray cattle and pending sugarcane dues, but that report is district-level. The issues are dated 2025, so check for updates.

negatives.english: The Khurja-Shikarpur road has been dilapidated for about 15 years
negatives.hindi: खुर्जा-शिकारपुर सड़क 15 साल से जर्जर है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (20 Dec 2024): the 13.65 km Khurja-Shikarpur road has been dilapidated for about 15 years; a Rs 22.11 crore renovation was sanctioned for about 35 villages, and the article says construction is still future work. Amar Ujala (7 Jul 2026) reports waterlogging on this road in front of the Shikarpur CHC and block office, which confirms the Shikarpur town stretch. The Khurja end of the road may lie in another AC, which is not confirmed here.

notes: Identity: Wikipedia list gives No. 69 Shikarpur, district Bulandshahr, reserved None. The AC article's extent is 'Shikarpur Tehsil; PC Katiyawali of Jahangirabad KC of Anupshahr Tehsil', so the town of Shikarpur (municipal board, pop. 33,130 in 2011 per Wikipedia) is inside the AC under the namesake rule. Syana and Anupshahr places were excluded because they are not confirmed inside this AC. Current MLA is unconfirmed and was left out of all statements: the AC Wikipedia page lists Anil Sharma (BJP), while a Wikipedia search result and a Chetnamanch report say he died on 2 Sept 2026, and a 2022 Amar Ujala result lists Anil Kumar (BJP) as the winner. Electoral figures are excluded per the brief. Most positives are planned or sanctioned works, not delivered ones (no completed Shikarpur project found in searches), so these are flagged as inference. The Shikarpur CHC allegations are unverified and need a field check. The Bulandshahr-Shikarpur route ETV demand (Ganga Expressway access) was not used because the source does not confirm a Shikarpur-specific place. Field check suggested: drain status at Balaji Market and Kotwali turn, CHC pharmacy and prescription practice, the 33 KVA Shikarpur feeders, and whether the Anupshahr-Shikarpur road widening and the Khurja-Shikarpur road renovation have started.
